introduce:
Sit on a chair with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward. Curl your back smoothly and place your hands on the tops of your thighs.

Inhale, lift and reach your left hand toward the ceiling with your palm facing upward, arching your torso to the left with your gaze over your right shoulder.

Exhale, slowly transition back to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
name: CHAIR ARCH AND CURL WITH ONE ARM RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Perform this flow slowly and with control.
Inhale as you arch your torso, and exhale as you curl it.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
This exercise stretches your upper body.
This exercise helps improve your shoulder and spinal flexibility.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs together and your hands resting on your thighs. Keep your back straight and your gaze forward.

Inhale, lift your feet off the floor, open them wide to the sides, and lower them down. Exhale, bend your torso forward.

Return to an upright seated position. Lift your feet off the floor again and bring your legs back together while lowering them to the floor, followed by leaning forward.

Repeat the flow with a steady rhythm.
name: CHAIR HIP OPENER

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Exhale as you lean forward, and inhale as you return.
Keep your knees and toes aligned.
This exercise stretches your spine and hips.

introduce:
Sit sideways on a chair with your gaze to the left. Position your left leg in a lunge with your foot flat on the floor, and bend your right leg back with your toes touching the floor.

Press your left hand on your left thigh and reach your right arm backward. Exhale, curl your back smoothly.

Inhale, arch your back while your right arm follows your torso and draws an arc along the side of your body. Simultaneously, straighten your right leg, feeling the stretch along your spine.

Exhale, transition back to the starting position, and repeat the flow with a steady rhythm.
name: CHAIR ARCH AND CURL IN LEFT LUNGE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Inhale as you arch your back, and exhale as you curl it.
Perform this flow slowly and with control.
Avoid over-arching your back.
Make sure there is enough distance between your feet.
This exercise stretches your chest, shoulders, spine, and legs.
This exercise improves your posture and relieves tension.

introduce:

Inhale, arch your back while your left arm follows your torso and draws an arc along the side of your body. Simultaneously, straighten your left leg, feeling the stretch along your spine.

Exhale, transition back to the starting position, and repeat the flow with a steady rhythm.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet much wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing outward. Place your hands on your thighs, keep your back straight, and gaze forward.

Swing your torso to the left in a wave-like motion while sliding your left hand along your thigh toward your knee.

Swing to the other side and repeat on both sides alternately.
name: CHAIR SIDE TO SIDE ARCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Maintain steady breathing.
Let your head move naturally with your torso.
Avoid leaning forward or backward.
Perform the flow slowly and fluidly.
This exercise improves your spinal flexibility.
This exercise stretches the sides of your torso and relieves tension.

introduce:
Sit on the chair in a lunge position with your left leg bent and your right leg extended to the side, keeping your feet flat on the floor with your toes pointing to the sides.

Keep your back straight, take your gaze forward, and extend your arms to the sides.

Inhale, bend your torso to the left, raising your right hand overhead as it follows your torso, while your left hand reaches toward your right leg, creating a long line along your right side.

Exhale, transition back to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
name: CHAIR SIDE BEND FLOW LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Inhale as you bend to the side, exhale as you return to the center.
Don't let your bent knee pass your toes.
Always keep your back leg straight and your feet grounded.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
Avoid leaning forward or backward.
This exercise helps improve your spinal and shoulder flexibility.
This exercise stretches the sides of your torso and relieves tension.

introduce:
Sit on the chair in a lunge position with your right leg bent and your left leg extended to the side, keeping your feet flat on the floor with your toes pointing to the sides.

Keep your back straight, take your gaze forward, and extend your arms to the sides.

Inhale, bend your torso to the right, raising your left hand overhead as it follows your torso, while your right hand reaches toward your left leg, creating a long line along your left side.

Exhale, transition back to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward. Place your hands on your thighs, keep your back straight, and gaze forward.

Exhale, twist your torso to the right while sliding your right hand toward your waist and your left hand toward your knee. Follow your right shoulder with your gaze.

Inhale, transition back to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
name: CHAIR SPIRALING TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet hip-width apart and your toes touching the floor.

Inhale, extend your left leg forward with your toes touching the floor, rotate your torso to the left, and slide your right hand down along your left leg while your left hand extends backward and upward.

Exhale, transition back to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST WITH HAMSTRING STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Inhale as you twist your torso, and exhale as you return.
Let your gaze follow the movement of your torso.
Reach your hands as far as possible to deepen the stretch.
This exercise improves the flexibility of your spine and shoulders.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet hip-width apart. Grip the sides of the chair behind you to support your torso. Keep your chest up and your back straight.

Exhale, bring one knee as close to your chest as possible.

Inhale, return to the starting position, and switch legs to repeat.
name: CHAIR SINGLE LEG PUMP

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
Perform this movement slowly and with control.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
This exercise strengthens your core and legs.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, keeping your chest up and your back straight. Stack your hands over your navel and close your eyes.

Take a deep breath, sweep your hands from the sides up to the top of your head and stack them. Breathe out deeply and lower your hands to your navel.

Take a few deep breaths in and out, feeling the flow of energy and calmness within your body.
name: CHAIR BACK TO CENTER

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

This exercise helps release tension and stress.
